scene.id: Empat kotak kecil: Kakek memancing, Nenek menari dengan kipas di alun-alun, Kakak bermain basket, dan Adik menggambar.
scene.en: Four small panels: Grandpa fishing, Grandma doing square dancing with a fan, Big Brother playing basketball and Little Sister drawing.

scene.id: Seekor kelinci putih duduk di atas salju; di sebelahnya seekor kelinci hitam sebagai pembanding.
scene.en: A white rabbit sits in the snow; next to it is a black rabbit for contrast.

scene.id: Foto kelas: guru dan para murid berbaris tiga baris dan tersenyum.
scene.en: A class photo: the teacher and the students stand in three rows, smiling.

scene.id: Kalender tahunan dibagi dua; enam bulan pertama disorot, dan Adik menunjuk separuh itu.
scene.en: A year calendar split in two; the first six months are highlighted and Little Sister points at that half.

scene.id: Panel 1, pagi: Ibu mulai mencoba baju di toko. Panel 2, siang: Ayah masih menunggu di bangku, tertidur bersandar pada tas belanja.
scene.en: Panel 1, morning: Mom starts trying on clothes in a shop. Panel 2, midday: Dad is still waiting on the bench, asleep against the shopping bags.

scene.id: Kakak membantu Kakek mengangkat kotak yang berat.
scene.en: Big Brother helps Grandpa lift a heavy box.

scene.id: Adik membantu Ibu menata piring dan mangkuk di meja makan.
scene.en: Little Sister helps Mom set plates and bowls on the dinner table.

scene.id: Ibu membuka tas tangannya dan mengeluarkan sebungkus biskuit untuk Adik.
scene.en: Mom opens her handbag and takes out a packet of biscuits for Little Sister.

scene.id: Penjual menaruh tiga gelas bubble tea berjajar di meja kios, dengan angka 3 di atasnya.
scene.en: The seller lines up three cups of bubble tea on the stall counter, with the digit 3 above them.

scene.id: Peta dengan mawar angin tanpa huruf; sisi atas (utara) disorot dan jarum kompas merah menunjuk ke sana, ke arah gunung bersalju.
scene.en: A map with a letterless compass rose; the top side (north) is highlighted and a red compass needle points that way, toward snowy mountains.

scene.id: Peta kecil: taman di tengah; stasiun kereta di sisi utara (atas) taman disorot. Ada mawar angin di pojok.
scene.en: A small map: a park in the middle; the train station on the north (top) side of the park is highlighted. A compass rose sits in the corner.

scene.id: Kuil Langit dengan atap bundar biru di tengah kota; gang hutong beratap abu-abu di depan dan Tembok Besar di kejauhan.
scene.en: The Temple of Heaven with its round blue roof; grey-roofed hutong lanes in front and the Great Wall in the distance.

scene.id: Sebuah buku tulis berspiral dengan sampul bergaris; pensil tergeletak di atasnya.
scene.en: A spiral notebook with a striped cover; a pencil lies on top.

scene.id: Ayah dan Kakak berdiri saling memunggungi untuk membandingkan tinggi badan; Ibu meletakkan tangannya di atas kepala mereka.
scene.en: Dad and Big Brother stand back to back to compare heights; Mom rests her hand flat across the tops of their heads.

scene.id: Adik hendak menyentuh panci panas di atas kompor. Ibu mengangkat telapak tangan untuk menahannya (balon berisi tanda silang).
scene.en: Little Sister reaches for a hot pot on the stove. Mom raises her palm to stop her (bubble with a cross).

scene.id: Penjual menawarkan baju merah. Ibu menggeleng dan menunjuk baju-baju lain di rak.
scene.en: The seller offers a red top. Mom shakes her head and points at the other clothes on the rack.

scene.id: Kakak berdiri di dalam lingkaran; di luar lingkaran ada teman kuliah, guru, dan penjual. Kakak menunjuk mereka.
scene.en: Big Brother stands inside a circle; outside it are his classmate, the teacher and the seller. He points at them.

scene.id: Kakek berbaring di ranjang rumah sakit; dokter memeriksanya dengan stetoskop.
scene.en: Grandpa lies in a hospital bed; the doctor checks him with a stethoscope.

scene.id: Penjual menunjukkan semangka yang tidak terlalu besar, ukurannya sedang; Ibu menimbangnya di tangan dengan wajah biasa saja.
scene.en: The seller shows a watermelon that isn't very big, just medium-sized; Mom weighs it in her hand with a so-so face.

scene.id: Di papan tulis tertulis 2 + 2 = 5. Guru menggeleng dan menandainya dengan tanda silang merah; Adik menggaruk kepala.
scene.en: The blackboard shows 2 + 2 = 5. The teacher shakes her head and marks it with a red cross; Little Sister scratches her head.

scene.id: Ayah hendak membuka payung. Kakek menunjuk langit yang cerah dan mengibaskan tangan.
scene.en: Dad is about to open an umbrella. Grandpa points at the clear, sunny sky and waves the idea away.

scene.id: Puzzle hampir selesai, tinggal kurang satu keping; Adik mencari-cari keping yang hilang itu.
scene.en: The jigsaw is almost finished, with just one piece missing; Little Sister hunts for it.

scene.id: Kalender mingguan dengan tanda centang di lima dari tujuh kotak; di sebelahnya Kakek duduk di bangku taman favoritnya.
scene.en: A weekly calendar with ticks in five of the seven boxes; next to it Grandpa sits on his favourite park bench.

scene.id: Tiga panel kecil: Kakek memberi makan burung di taman saat cerah, saat hujan dengan payung, dan saat bersalju.
scene.en: Three small panels: Grandpa feeds the birds in the park on a sunny day, on a rainy day with an umbrella, and on a snowy day.

scene.id: Di ruang karaoke berlampu warna-warni, Ayah dan Kakak bernyanyi dengan mikrofon; Ibu bertepuk tangan.
scene.en: In a karaoke room with colourful lights, Dad and Big Brother sing into microphones; Mom claps.

scene.id: Di gerbang tiket stasiun, Ayah memegang tiket kereta dengan nomor kursi 12.
scene.en: At the station ticket gate, Dad holds a train ticket showing seat number 12.

scene.id: Potongan mobil: Kakek duduk di kursi depan, Adik di kursi belakang memakai sabuk pengaman.
scene.en: A cutaway of a car: Grandpa sits in the front seat and Little Sister in the back with her seat belt on.

scene.id: Halte bus beratap dengan bangku dan papan berikon bus; Nenek duduk menunggu.
scene.en: A covered bus stop with a bench and a sign with a bus icon; Grandma sits waiting.

scene.id: Seluruh keluarga duduk mengelilingi meja bundar dan makan bersama; mangkuk nasi dan lauk ada di tengah meja.
scene.en: The whole family sits around a round table eating together; rice bowls and dishes fill the middle of the table.

scene.id: Seekor anak ayam keluar dari cangkang telur yang retak; panah mengarah ke luar.
scene.en: A chick comes out of its cracked eggshell; an arrow points outward.

scene.id: Ibu berdiri di luar tirai dan memanggil; Adik keluar dari balik tirai ke arah Ibu. Panah mengarah ke Ibu.
scene.en: Mom stands outside the curtain and calls; Little Sister comes out from behind it toward her. An arrow points toward Mom.

scene.id: Kakak memakai sepatu lalu keluar rumah, menjauh dari Nenek yang tetap di dalam; panah mengarah menjauhi Nenek.
scene.en: Big Brother puts on his shoes and heads out of the house, away from Grandma, who stays inside; an arrow points away from her.

scene.id: Tempat tidur rapi dengan bantal empuk dan selimut bergaris.
scene.en: A neatly made bed with a fluffy pillow and a striped blanket.

scene.id: Adik melompat tali; tiga bayangan gerakannya berjajar dengan angka 1, 2, 3.
scene.en: Little Sister jumps rope; three motion snapshots of her are lined up with the digits 1, 2, 3.

scene.id: Garis putus-putus berawal dari rumah (titik awalnya disorot) menuju sekolah; Kakak baru melangkah keluar dari pintu rumah.
scene.en: A dotted line starts at the house (its starting point highlighted) and leads to the school; Big Brother is just stepping out of the front door.

scene.id: Adik memakai sepatu terbalik, kiri di kaki kanan. Ibu menunjuknya sambil tertawa; ada tanda silang di atas sepatu. Di sebelahnya sepasang sepatu yang dipakai benar.
scene.en: Little Sister has her shoes on the wrong feet. Mom points and laughs; a cross sits above the shoes. Next to them is a pair worn the right way.

scene.id: Kakak memukul bola ping-pong dengan bet; bola melesat melewati net.
scene.en: Big Brother hits a ping-pong ball with his paddle; the ball zips over the net.

scene.id: Ayah memesan taksi lewat ponsel di pinggir jalan; taksi berhenti dan sopir menurunkan kaca jendela.
scene.en: Dad books a taxi on his phone at the roadside; the taxi pulls up and the driver rolls down the window.

scene.id: Adik membuka tutup kotak hadiah; cahaya berkilauan keluar dari dalamnya.
scene.en: Little Sister lifts the lid of a gift box; sparkling light spills out.

scene.id: Kakak dan teman kuliahnya bermain basket di lapangan; Kakak melompat untuk menembak.
scene.en: Big Brother and his classmate play basketball on the court; Big Brother jumps to shoot.

scene.id: Guru menempelkan stiker bintang di buku Adik; Adik menerimanya dengan bangga.
scene.en: The teacher puts a gold star sticker in Little Sister's book; she receives it proudly.

scene.id: Adik berjalan pelan-pelan dan hati-hati sambil membawa semangkuk sup penuh di atas nampan.
scene.en: Little Sister walks slowly and carefully, carrying a full bowl of soup on a tray.

scene.id: Kakak menunggu di halte sambil melirik jam tangan; bus terlihat kecil di kejauhan.
scene.en: Big Brother waits at the bus stop, glancing at his watch; a bus is a tiny shape in the distance.

scene.id: Kakek berjongkok menanam bibit di tanah kebun; tangannya penuh tanah.
scene.en: Grandpa crouches to plant a seedling in the garden soil; his hands are covered in earth.

scene.id: Ayah melihat peta di ponselnya; pin merah menandai tempat janjian, dan bangunan itu tampak di kejauhan.
scene.en: Dad checks a map on his phone; a red pin marks the meeting place, and that building can be seen in the distance.

scene.id: Di kereta metro yang penuh, Kakak celingukan dan akhirnya menemukan satu kursi kosong.
scene.en: On a crowded metro train, Big Brother looks around and finally finds one empty seat.

scene.id: Mainan berserakan di lantai; Ibu menunjuk ke lantai dengan alis terangkat.
scene.en: Toys are scattered all over the floor; Mom points at the floor with raised eyebrows.

scene.id: Ayah dan Adik membentangkan peta kertas besar bergambar sungai, jalan, dan gunung.
scene.en: Dad and Little Sister spread out a big paper map showing rivers, roads and mountains.

scene.id: Steker dicolokkan ke stopkontak; ikon petir kecil mengalir lewat kabel dan lampu menyala.
scene.en: A plug goes into the socket; a little lightning icon runs along the cable and the lamp lights up.

scene.id: Televisi layar datar yang mati di dinding ruang tamu, dengan remote di meja di bawahnya.
scene.en: A switched-off flat-screen TV on the living-room wall, with the remote on the stand below.

scene.id: Peta dengan mawar angin tanpa huruf; sisi kanan (timur) disorot dan matahari terbit di sisi itu.
scene.en: A map with a letterless compass rose; the right side (east) is highlighted and the sun rises on that side.

scene.id: Peta kecil: taman di tengah; sekolah di sisi timur (kanan) taman disorot. Ada mawar angin di pojok.
scene.en: A small map: a park in the middle; the school on the east (right) side of the park is highlighted. A compass rose sits in the corner.

scene.id: Main "patung": Adik diam membeku, sedangkan tangan Kakak bergerak dan ketahuan; ada garis-garis gerak di tangan Kakak.
scene.en: Playing "statues": Little Sister stays frozen, but Big Brother's hand moves and he gets caught; motion lines around his hand.

scene.id: Kakek memperagakan gerakan tai chi dalam tiga tahap; garis putus-putus menunjukkan alur gerak tangannya.
scene.en: Grandpa demonstrates a tai chi movement in three stages; dotted lines show the path of his hands.

scene.id: Kakak lemas memegang perutnya yang keroncongan sambil menatap kukusan bakpao. Di sebelahnya, Kakak bersandar kenyang dan puas.
scene.en: Big Brother droops, holding his rumbling tummy and staring at a steamer of buns. Next to it, he leans back, full and satisfied.

scene.id: Ayah dan Ibu berdiri di depan gedung apartemen baru sambil mengangkat kunci rumah mereka dengan gembira.
scene.en: Dad and Mom stand in front of a new apartment block, happily holding up the key to their home.

scene.id: Adik dengan hati-hati menaruh sebuah apel di atas meja.
scene.en: Little Sister carefully puts an apple down on the table.

scene.id: Kakak melempar tas sekolahnya ke udara dan memakai topi pantai; di kalender, deretan hari libur disorot.
scene.en: Big Brother tosses his schoolbag in the air and puts on a beach hat; on the calendar a row of holiday days is highlighted.

scene.id: Sore hari, gerbang sekolah terbuka; Adik berlari keluar ke pelukan Kakek yang menjemputnya.
scene.en: In the afternoon the school gate opens; Little Sister runs out into the arms of Grandpa, who has come to pick her up.

scene.id: Seekor burung terbang di atas gedung; Adik merentangkan kedua tangan, pura-pura ikut terbang.
scene.en: A bird flies over the buildings; Little Sister spreads her arms wide, pretending to fly too.

scene.id: Angin kencang meniup daun-daun dan rambut Nenek; topi Ayah terbang ke udara.
scene.en: A strong wind blows the leaves and Grandma's hair; Dad's hat flies up into the air.

scene.id: Handuk kering yang mengembang di jemuran di bawah matahari, di samping handuk basah yang meneteskan air.
scene.en: A fluffy dry towel on the clothesline under the sun, next to a wet towel dripping water.

scene.id: Dua piring berdampingan: satu bersih berkilau, satu kotor penuh noda saus. Ibu mengangkat yang bersih.
scene.en: Two plates side by side: one sparkling clean, one dirty with sauce stains. Mom holds up the clean one.

scene.id: Kakak sibuk menyapu dan mengepel lantai dengan lengan baju tergulung dan keringat di dahi.
scene.en: Big Brother is busy sweeping and mopping the floor, sleeves rolled up and sweat on his forehead.

scene.id: Ibu membuka pintu kamar dan melihat Kakak mengobrak-abrik lemari; Ibu berkacak pinggang dan bertanya (balon tanda tanya).
scene.en: Mom opens the bedroom door and finds Big Brother turning the wardrobe upside down; hands on hips, she asks (question-mark bubble).

scene.id: Gedung pencakar langit yang tinggi menjulang di samping sebuah rumah kecil satu lantai.
scene.en: A tall skyscraper towers next to a small one-storey house.

scene.id: Adik berbisik di telinga Ibu dengan tangan menutupi mulut; mata Ibu membulat terkejut.
scene.en: Little Sister whispers in Mom's ear with a hand cupped round her mouth; Mom's eyes go wide in surprise.

scene.id: Adik berjalan di belakang Ayah, menirukan setiap langkahnya persis seperti anak bebek mengikuti induknya.
scene.en: Little Sister walks behind Dad, copying every step he takes like a duckling following its mother.

scene.id: Kakek menunjukkan foto lama dirinya waktu muda sebagai pekerja pabrik, memakai helm kerja dan baju kerja biru.
scene.en: Grandpa shows an old photo of himself as a young factory worker in a hard hat and blue overalls.

scene.id: Ibu menekan sakelar dan lampu kamar padam; separuh ruangan menjadi gelap.
scene.en: Mom flicks the switch and the room light goes off; half the room turns dark.

scene.id: Kakak menutup pintu lemari yang penuh sesak dengan mendorongnya kuat-kuat sampai rapat.
scene.en: Big Brother pushes the door of the overstuffed wardrobe hard until it shuts.

scene.id: Peta dunia dengan negara-negara berwarna berbeda; Kakak menunjuk satu negara.
scene.en: A world map with countries in different colours; Big Brother points at one.

scene.id: Ayah menarik koper menuju pesawat; di balon pikirannya, panah melintas keluar dari batas negara di peta.
scene.en: Dad pulls his suitcase toward a plane; in his thought bubble, an arrow crosses out over the country's border on a map.

scene.id: Kakak menggandeng Nenek menyeberang jalan di zebra cross; panah melintasi jalan.
scene.en: Big Brother walks Grandma across the road at the zebra crossing; an arrow goes across the road.

scene.id: Penjual menyodorkan dua gelas bubble tea, satu rasa stroberi dan satu rasa taro ungu; Adik ragu memilih (tanda tanya).
scene.en: The seller holds out two cups of bubble tea, one strawberry and one purple taro; Little Sister can't decide (question mark).

scene.id: Kakak baru menghabiskan satu bakpao; Nenek membuka kukusan berikutnya, dan masih ada banyak lagi.
scene.en: Big Brother has just finished a steamed bun; Grandma opens another steamer, and there are lots more.

scene.id: Adik bersembunyi di belakang pohon; hanya kuncirnya yang terlihat dari balik batang.
scene.en: Little Sister hides behind a tree; only her pigtails stick out from behind the trunk.

scene.id: Kalender: panah melompati satu kotak dan mendarat dua hari ke depan di kotak bergambar kue; Adik menghitung dengan dua jari.
scene.en: A calendar: an arrow skips one box and lands two days ahead on a box with a cake; Little Sister counts on two fingers.

scene.id: Bunga merah mekar di pot di balkon; Nenek membungkuk menciumnya.
scene.en: A red flower blooms in a pot on the balcony; Grandma bends down to smell it.

scene.id: Ayah dan Kakek mengobrol sambil minum teh; banyak balon kata kosong melayang di antara mereka.
scene.en: Dad and Grandpa chat over tea; lots of empty speech bubbles float between them.

scene.id: Kakak menatap sedih ponselnya yang layarnya retak dan tidak menyala; di sebelahnya ada ponsel yang utuh dan menyala.
scene.en: Big Brother looks sadly at his phone, its screen cracked and dark; next to it is an intact phone that lights up.

scene.id: Kakak mengembalikan buku yang ia pinjam kepada guru; panah mengarah dari Kakak ke guru.
scene.en: Big Brother gives back the book he borrowed to the teacher; an arrow goes from him to her.

scene.id: Guru menunjuk; Kakak berdiri dan menjawab dengan yakin (balon berisi tanda seru dan centang).
scene.en: The teacher points; Big Brother stands up and answers confidently (bubble with an exclamation mark and a tick).

scene.id: Setelah perjalanan jauh, Ayah dan Kakek tiba kembali di rumah tua berpintu merah di desa asal Kakek; Kakek tersenyum haru.
scene.en: After a long journey, Dad and Grandpa arrive back at the old red-doored house in Grandpa's home village; Grandpa smiles, moved.

scene.id: Ayah membuka pintu apartemen sambil menenteng tas kerja; Adik berlari menyambutnya. Panah menunjuk ke dalam rumah.
scene.en: Dad opens the apartment door carrying his briefcase; Little Sister runs to greet him. An arrow points into the home.

scene.id: Nenek di dapur menoleh; Kakek baru pulang dari pasar dan masuk ke arahnya membawa sayur. Panah mengarah ke Nenek.
scene.en: Grandma looks round in the kitchen; Grandpa, just back from the market, comes in toward her carrying vegetables. An arrow points toward Grandma.

scene.id: Teman Adik berpamitan di pintu lalu berjalan pulang menjauh ke rumahnya di kejauhan; Ibu dan Adik melambai. Panah mengarah ke rumah teman.
scene.en: Little Sister's friend says goodbye at the door and walks off toward her own home in the distance; Mom and Little Sister wave. An arrow points to the friend's home.

scene.id: Bandara: pesawat di landasan terlihat lewat kaca besar terminal; Ayah menarik koper.
scene.en: An airport: a plane on the runway seen through the big terminal windows; Dad pulls a suitcase.

scene.id: Di konter bandara, Ibu menunjukkan tiket pesawat di layar ponselnya; ada ikon pesawat di layar.
scene.en: At the airport counter, Mom shows her plane ticket on her phone screen; a plane icon is on the screen.

scene.id: Ayah mencatat sesuatu di buku kecil sambil menjepit ponsel di antara bahu dan telinga.
scene.en: Dad jots something down in a little notebook while holding the phone between his shoulder and ear.

scene.id: Nenek memandangi foto lama dan tersenyum; balon pikirannya berisi hari pernikahannya dengan Kakek.
scene.en: Grandma gazes at an old photo and smiles; her thought bubble shows her wedding day with Grandpa.

scene.id: Adik menghafal: matanya terpejam, jari di pelipis, kartu hafalan di tangan.
scene.en: Little Sister memorises: eyes shut, finger on her temple, a flashcard in her hand.

scene.id: Potongan rumah: di dalam, Ibu memasak, Kakek membaca, dan Adik bermain; di luar sedang hujan.
scene.en: A cutaway of the home: inside, Mom cooks, Grandpa reads and Little Sister plays; outside it is raining.

scene.id: Denah rumah dilihat dari atas dengan tiga kamar, masing-masing diberi angka 1, 2, dan 3.
scene.en: A top-down floor plan of a home with three rooms, numbered 1, 2 and 3.

scene.id: Kakak dan teman kuliahnya bertemu di kedai kopi dekat kampus: saling melambai dari jauh, lalu duduk berhadapan.
scene.en: Big Brother and his classmate meet at a coffee shop near campus: they wave to each other from afar, then sit face to face.

scene.id: Guru menjelaskan di depan papan tulis sambil menunjuk gambar apel; para murid memperhatikan.
scene.en: The teacher explains at the blackboard, pointing to a picture of an apple; the students pay attention.

scene.id: Gedung kelas lima lantai dengan deretan jendela kelas; guru menaiki tangga depan.
scene.en: A five-storey teaching building with rows of classroom windows; the teacher climbs the front steps.

scene.id: Kakak membawa teman kuliahnya pulang dan memperkenalkannya ke Ayah dan Ibu, telapak tangan terbuka ke arah temannya.
scene.en: Big Brother brings his classmate home and introduces him to Mom and Dad, an open palm toward his friend.

scene.id: Kakak melangkah masuk lewat pintu kelas; panah mengarah ke dalam.
scene.en: Big Brother steps in through the classroom door; an arrow points inside.

scene.id: Guru di dalam kelas melambai; Kakak yang berdiri di pintu masuk ke arahnya. Panah mengarah ke guru.
scene.en: The teacher inside the classroom beckons; Big Brother at the door comes in toward her. An arrow points toward the teacher.

scene.id: Ayah berdiri di luar dan mendorong lembut Adik masuk ke ruang dokter; panah mengarah menjauhi Ayah.
scene.en: Dad stands outside and gently nudges Little Sister into the doctor's room; an arrow points away from Dad.

scene.id: Begitu bel sekolah berbunyi, Kakak langsung melesat keluar kelas dengan tas di bahu.
scene.en: As soon as the school bell rings, Big Brother shoots straight out of the classroom with his bag on his shoulder.

scene.id: Ayah berdiri di ujung meja rapat sambil menunjuk grafik batang di layar; di laptop tampak kotak-kotak wajah kecil rekan kerjanya.
scene.en: Dad stands at the end of a meeting table pointing at a bar chart on the screen; a laptop shows little boxes with his colleagues' faces.

scene.id: Kakak memakai kacamata berhidung palsu dan mengagetkan Adik; lalu keduanya tertawa.
scene.en: Big Brother puts on fake nose-and-glasses and startles Little Sister; then they both burst out laughing.

scene.id: Kakak melihat bus datang di ujung jalan dan menunjuknya.
scene.en: Big Brother sees the bus coming at the end of the road and points at it.

scene.id: Kakak mengerjakan soal di mejanya; keringat menetes dan pensilnya bergerak cepat.
scene.en: Big Brother works through test questions at his desk; sweat drips and his pencil moves fast.

scene.id: Ruang ujian: deretan meja, murid-murid menulis dengan serius, guru mengawasi, jam di dinding.
scene.en: An exam room: rows of desks, students writing seriously, the teacher keeping watch, a clock on the wall.

scene.id: Kakak berkeringat di bawah terik matahari, lidahnya terjulur, menatap botol air. Di sebelahnya, Kakak segar setelah minum.
scene.en: Big Brother sweats under the blazing sun, tongue out, staring at a water bottle. Next to it, he looks refreshed after a drink.

scene.id: Buku pelajaran terbuka dengan gambar-gambar berwarna; Adik menunjuk satu halaman.
scene.en: An open textbook with colourful pictures; Little Sister points at one page.

scene.id: Kakak membaca keras-keras satu bacaan di buku pelajaran; baris-baris abu-abu mewakili teksnya.
scene.en: Big Brother reads a lesson text aloud from his textbook; grey lines stand in for the text.

scene.id: Kakak berlari kencang melewati Kakek, dengan garis-garis kecepatan; panah menunjuk Kakak.
scene.en: Big Brother dashes past Grandpa with speed lines; an arrow points at Big Brother.

scene.id: Keluarga Xiǎo tiba di kaki Tembok Besar; Adik melompat girang.
scene.en: The Xiǎo family arrives at the foot of the Great Wall; Little Sister jumps for joy.

scene.id: Kakek yang tua dengan rambut putih dan tongkat berdiri di samping Adik yang masih kecil.
scene.en: Old Grandpa, with white hair and a walking stick, stands next to young Little Sister.

scene.id: Kakek dan Nenek duduk di bangku taman; Kakek memegang tongkat.
scene.en: Grandpa and Grandma sit on a park bench; Grandpa holds a walking stick.

scene.id: Ayah pulang kerja dan terkapar di sofa, keringatan, dasinya longgar; di sebelahnya, Ayah di pagi hari yang segar bugar.
scene.en: Dad gets home from work and collapses on the sofa, sweaty with his tie loose; next to it, fresh and lively morning Dad.

scene.id: Kulkas terbuka: di dalamnya ada susu, telur, dan semangka. Kakak melongok ke dalam.
scene.en: An open fridge: inside are milk, eggs and a watermelon. Big Brother peers in.

scene.id: Gedung apartemen bertingkat dengan angka lantai 1 sampai 6 di sisinya; Kakak melambai dari jendela lantai paling atas.
scene.en: A multi-storey apartment building with floor numbers 1 to 6 down its side; Big Brother waves from a top-floor window.

scene.id: Potongan gedung dua lantai: Adik di lantai atas melambai ke bawah; Ayah di lantai bawah mendongak. Panah ke atas menunjuk Adik.
scene.en: A cutaway of a two-storey building: Little Sister on the upper floor waves down; Dad on the lower floor looks up. An up arrow points at her.

scene.id: Kakak melongok dari jendela lantai atas dan menunjuk ke bawah, ke Kakek yang menunggu di halaman gedung. Panah ke bawah menunjuk Kakek.
scene.en: Big Brother leans out of an upstairs window and points down at Grandpa waiting in the courtyard below. A down arrow points at Grandpa.

scene.id: Jalan panjang berkelok menuju gunung; Ayah dan Kakak berjalan di atasnya.
scene.en: A long winding road leads to the mountains; Dad and Big Brother walk along it.

scene.id: Perempatan jalan dengan lampu lalu lintas dan zebra cross; mobil datang dari empat arah.
scene.en: A crossroads with traffic lights and zebra crossings; cars come from four directions.

scene.id: Dalam perjalanan ke kampus, Kakak membeli bakpao di kios pinggir jalan; garis putus-putus menunjukkan rute dari rumah ke kampus.
scene.en: On the way to campus, Big Brother buys a steamed bun from a roadside stall; a dotted line shows the route from home to campus.

scene.id: Jalan raya lebar dengan beberapa lajur; bus dan mobil melaju, trotoar di tepinya.
scene.en: A wide road with several lanes; buses and cars drive along, with pavements at the sides.

scene.id: Ibu baru selesai memesan, dan penjual sudah menyodorkan bubble tea dengan secepat kilat; ada garis-garis kecepatan.
scene.en: Mom has only just ordered and the seller is already handing over the bubble tea in a flash; speed lines all around.

scene.id: Kakek berjalan pelan-pelan dengan tongkat sementara Kakak melesat melewatinya; panah menunjuk Kakek.
scene.en: Grandpa walks slowly with his stick as Big Brother zooms past; an arrow points at Grandpa.

scene.id: Sepuluh koin kecil berjajar, tanda sama dengan, lalu satu koin besar.
scene.en: Ten small coins in a row, an equals sign, then one big coin.

scene.id: Ibu bertanya sambil menunjuk mangkuk; Adik menggeleng, dan mangkuk nasinya masih penuh tidak tersentuh.
scene.en: Mom asks, pointing at the bowl; Little Sister shakes her head, and her bowl of rice is still full and untouched.

scene.id: Ibu melihat Kakak termenung dan bertanya (balon tanda tanya). Kakak mengangkat bahu sambil tersenyum, balonnya kosong.
scene.en: Mom sees Big Brother lost in thought and asks (question-mark bubble). He shrugs with a smile; his bubble is empty.

scene.id: Pintu apartemen merah dengan gagang bulat; Ayah memegang gagangnya dan membukanya.
scene.en: A red apartment door with a round handle; Dad holds the handle and opens it.

scene.id: Sepasang sepatu dan sebuah paket tergeletak tepat di depan pintu apartemen; Adik mengintip dari balik pintu.
scene.en: A pair of shoes and a parcel sit right outside the apartment door; Little Sister peeks out from behind it.

scene.id: Di gerbang kebun binatang, Kakek menyerahkan dua tiket masuk; di balik gerbang tampak panda.
scene.en: At the zoo gate, Grandpa hands over two entry tickets; a panda can be seen beyond the gate.

scene.id: Panel 1: Adik bingung menatap soal (tanda tanya). Panel 2: bohlam menyala di atas kepalanya dan ia tersenyum lebar.
scene.en: Panel 1: Little Sister stares at a problem, confused (question mark). Panel 2: a light bulb switches on above her head and she grins.

scene.id: Kakek mengambil cangkir teh dari meja dan memegangnya dengan satu tangan.
scene.en: Grandpa picks up a teacup from the table and holds it in one hand.

scene.id: Adik menghabiskan segelas susu dan tersenyum dengan kumis susu putih di atas bibirnya.
scene.en: Little Sister finishes a glass of milk and grins with a white milk moustache.

scene.id: Nenek bersanggul abu-abu dan berkardigan duduk di meja sambil membuat pangsit.
scene.en: Grandma, with her grey bun and cardigan, sits at the table making dumplings.

scene.id: Kakak, seorang anak laki-laki, menendang bola di halaman kompleks apartemen.
scene.en: Big Brother, a boy, kicks a ball in the courtyard of an apartment complex.

scene.id: Ayah, pria dewasa berkemeja, berdiri tegak dengan tangan di pinggang.
scene.en: Dad, a grown man in a shirt, stands tall with his hands on his hips.

scene.id: Kakak dan teman kuliahnya, dua cowok, bermain basket di lapangan kampus.
scene.en: Big Brother and his classmate, two young guys, play basketball on the campus court.

scene.id: Peta dengan mawar angin tanpa huruf; sisi bawah (selatan) disorot dan sekawanan burung terbang ke arah itu.
scene.en: A map with a letterless compass rose; the bottom side (south) is highlighted and a flock of birds flies that way.

scene.id: Peta kecil: taman di tengah; rumah sakit di sisi selatan (bawah) taman disorot. Ada mawar angin di pojok.
scene.en: A small map: a park in the middle; the hospital on the south (bottom) side of the park is highlighted. A compass rose sits in the corner.

scene.id: Kakak memegangi kepala di depan soal matematika yang panjang dan berbelit; di sebelahnya ada soal 1 + 1 yang mudah.
scene.en: Big Brother clutches his head in front of a long, tangled maths problem; next to it is an easy 1 + 1.

scene.id: Adik, anak perempuan berkuncir dua, melompat tali di halaman.
scene.en: Little Sister, a girl with two pigtails, jumps rope in the courtyard.

scene.id: Ibu, wanita dewasa, berdiri sambil menenteng tas belanja.
scene.en: Mom, a grown woman, stands holding a shopping bag.

scene.id: Di kelas, Adik yang berseragam sekolah mengangkat tangan dari bangkunya; guru menunjuknya.
scene.en: In class, Little Sister in her school uniform raises her hand from her desk; the teacher points to her.

scene.id: Adik duduk tepat di samping Kakek di bangku taman.
scene.en: Little Sister sits right beside Grandpa on a park bench.

scene.id: Kakak berlari kencang di lintasan lari; ada garis-garis kecepatan di belakangnya.
scene.en: Big Brother sprints along the running track with speed lines behind him.

scene.id: Adik memegang selembar tiket kertas bergerigi dengan bangga di depan loket.
scene.en: Little Sister proudly holds up a paper ticket with jagged edges in front of the ticket window.

scene.id: Kakek bangkit dari kursi malas dengan bertumpu pada tongkatnya; panah ke atas.
scene.en: Grandpa rises from his armchair, leaning on his walking stick; an up arrow.

scene.id: Guru masuk kelas; Kakak dan teman kuliahnya berdiri tegak dari kursi. Panah ke atas.
scene.en: The teacher walks into class; Big Brother and his classmate stand straight up from their chairs. An up arrow.

scene.id: Mobil keluarga Xiǎo diparkir di depan apartemen; Ayah memasukkan koper ke bagasi.
scene.en: The Xiǎo family's car is parked outside the apartment; Dad loads a suitcase into the boot.

scene.id: Di jalan, sebuah taksi melaju di depan bus; panah menunjuk taksi.
scene.en: On the road, a taxi drives in front of a bus; an arrow points at the taxi.

scene.id: Kalender: panah melompat mundur dua kotak dari hari ini ke kotak bergambar hujan; Kakak mengingat-ingat sambil menghitung dua jari.
scene.en: A calendar: an arrow jumps back two boxes from today to a box with rain in it; Big Brother remembers, counting on two fingers.

scene.id: Dompet kulit cokelat yang terbuka berisi kartu dan uang kertas; Ayah memegangnya.
scene.en: An open brown leather wallet with cards and banknotes inside; Dad holds it.

scene.id: Kakak demam di tempat tidur dengan termometer; Ibu menelepon guru untuk minta izin.
scene.en: Big Brother lies in bed with a fever and a thermometer; Mom phones the teacher to ask for a day off for him.

scene.id: Nenek membuka pintu lebar-lebar dan merentangkan tangan ke dalam, mempersilakan teman Adik masuk. Panah menunjuk ke dalam rumah.
scene.en: Grandma opens the door wide and sweeps her arm inward, inviting Little Sister's friend to come in. An arrow points into the home.

scene.id: Kakek menunjuk kursi kosong dengan telapak tangan terbuka, mempersilakan guru duduk.
scene.en: Grandpa points to an empty chair with an open palm, inviting the teacher to sit down.

scene.id: Bermacam bola di keranjang: bola basket, bola sepak, dan bola ping-pong.
scene.en: Different balls in a basket: a basketball, a football and a ping-pong ball.

scene.id: Kakak belajar dengan sangat serius, punggung tegak dan fokus penuh; di sebelahnya teman kuliah bermain ponsel.
scene.en: Big Brother studies very seriously, back straight and fully focused; next to him his classmate plays on his phone.

scene.id: Ayah memegang tiket kereta dan menunjuk tanggal yang sama (angka 8) di kalender meja.
scene.en: Dad holds a train ticket and points to the same date (the digit 8) on a desk calendar.

scene.id: Sepiring daging masak kecap yang mengilap; Kakak menatapnya dengan lapar.
scene.en: A plate of glossy braised pork; Big Brother stares at it hungrily.

scene.id: Tiga puncak gunung hijau di bawah awan, yang tengah paling tinggi; Kakek dan Adik mendaki jalan setapak.
scene.en: Three green mountain peaks under the clouds, the middle one tallest; Grandpa and Little Sister hike up a path.

scene.id: Mal besar bertingkat dengan eskalator di tengah; Ibu dan Adik menenteng tas belanja.
scene.en: A big multi-level shopping mall with escalators in the middle; Mom and Little Sister carry shopping bags.

scene.id: Boneka beruang duduk di rak paling atas; Adik berjinjit meraihnya. Panah menunjuk rak atas.
scene.en: A teddy bear sits on the top shelf; Little Sister stands on tiptoe to reach it. An arrow points at the top shelf.

scene.id: Nenek naik ke bus lewat pintu depan sambil memindai kode QR di mesin; panah mengarah ke dalam bus.
scene.en: Grandma steps onto the bus through the front door, scanning a QR code at the reader; an arrow points into the bus.

scene.id: Di restoran, Adik menunjuk ke balon kenangan di belakangnya: terakhir kali di sini ia menumpahkan semangkuk sup.
scene.en: In a restaurant, Little Sister points to a memory bubble behind her: last time here, she spilled a bowl of soup.

scene.id: Kakak berselancar di internet lewat laptop; ikon wifi melayang di atasnya.
scene.en: Big Brother browses the internet on his laptop; a wifi icon floats above.

scene.id: Adik diam-diam menempelkan stiker bintang di punggung Ayah; Ayah meraba-raba badannya mencarinya. Panah menunjuk stiker itu.
scene.en: Little Sister secretly sticks a star sticker on Dad's back; Dad pats himself all over looking for it. An arrow points at the sticker.

scene.id: Kakek senam pagi di taman dan memamerkan otot lengannya dengan bangga; badannya sehat dan bugar.
scene.en: Grandpa does his morning exercises in the park and proudly flexes his arm; he looks fit and healthy.

scene.id: Ibu berkacak pinggang dengan wajah merah padam melihat dinding yang dicoret-coret krayon; di sebelahnya Ibu yang sedang tersenyum senang.
scene.en: Mom stands with her hands on her hips, red in the face, looking at a wall covered in crayon scribbles; next to it is Mom smiling happily.

scene.id: Adik memakai topi pesta dan meniup lilin di kue ulang tahun; Ayah dan Ibu bertepuk tangan.
scene.en: Little Sister in a party hat blows out the candles on her birthday cake; Mom and Dad clap.

scene.id: Ibu mencoba baju di depan cermin kamar pas, memutar badan untuk melihat.
scene.en: Mom tries on a top in front of the fitting-room mirror, turning to look.

scene.id: Adik menunjuk foto anak kecil di ponsel Ayah, lalu menunjuk Ayah; di balonnya ada ikon centang dan silang.
scene.en: Little Sister points at a photo of a small child on Dad's phone, then at Dad; her bubble shows a tick and a cross.

scene.id: Adik mengangkat kedua telapak tangannya yang belepotan cat warna-warni.
scene.en: Little Sister holds up both hands, covered in colourful paint.

scene.id: Tas sekolah kuning yang besar dan penuh buku di punggung Adik.
scene.en: A big yellow schoolbag stuffed with books on Little Sister's back.

scene.id: Pohon besar yang rindang di taman kompleks; Kakek duduk berteduh di bawahnya.
scene.en: A big shady tree in the estate's park; Grandpa sits in its shade.

scene.id: Ayah mengantar Nenek ke stasiun; ia melambai saat kereta Nenek mulai berangkat.
scene.en: Dad sees Grandma off at the station, waving as her train starts to pull away.

scene.id: Bel pintu berbunyi; Kakak menoleh kaget dan ada gelombang suara di dekat telinganya.
scene.en: The doorbell rings; Big Brother turns in surprise, with sound waves by his ear.

scene.id: Guru membacakan kata (balon kosong); murid-murid menutup buku dan menulis apa yang mereka dengar di kertas.
scene.en: The teacher reads out words (empty speech bubble); the students keep their books shut and write what they hear on paper.

scene.id: Perpustakaan yang tenang: meja panjang dan rak-rak tinggi; Kakak belajar dengan buku tebal.
scene.en: A quiet library: long tables and tall shelves; Big Brother studies with a thick book.

scene.id: Adik melihat foto-foto liburan dari negara lain: kincir angin, piramida, dan menara.
scene.en: Little Sister looks at holiday photos from other countries: a windmill, a pyramid and a tower.

scene.id: Kakak memakai headphone dan belajar bahasa asing di laptop; balon kata berisi bendera-bendera kecil yang berbeda.
scene.en: Big Brother wears headphones and studies a foreign language on his laptop; the speech bubble holds several different little flags.

scene.id: Panel 1: Ibu memilih baju di layar ponsel dan menekan ikon keranjang belanja. Panel 2: keesokan harinya paket tiba di depan pintu.
scene.en: Panel 1: Mom picks a top on her phone screen and taps the shopping-cart icon. Panel 2: the next day a parcel arrives at the door.

scene.id: Kakak bermain game online sambil mengobrol lewat headset dengan teman yang hanya tampil sebagai avatar kartun di layar.
scene.en: Big Brother plays an online game, chatting through his headset with a friend who appears on screen only as a cartoon avatar.

scene.id: Ayah sudah di luar pintu dan meraba saku kosongnya; payungnya tertinggal di dalam rumah, sementara awan mendung datang.
scene.en: Dad is already outside the door, patting his empty pockets; his umbrella is left inside, and rain clouds are rolling in.

scene.id: Kakak tiba di kelas dan membuka tas, tapi buku PR-nya tidak ada; balon pikiran menunjukkan buku itu tertinggal di meja rumah.
scene.en: Big Brother gets to class and opens his bag, but his homework book isn't there; a thought bubble shows it left on the desk at home.

scene.id: Peta dengan mawar angin tanpa huruf; sisi kiri (barat) disorot dan matahari terbenam di sisi itu.
scene.en: A map with a letterless compass rose; the left side (west) is highlighted and the sun sets on that side.

scene.id: Peta kecil: taman di tengah; pasar di sisi barat (kiri) taman disorot. Ada mawar angin di pojok.
scene.en: A small map: a park in the middle; the market on the west (left) side of the park is highlighted. A compass rose sits in the corner.

scene.id: Ibu mencuci piring di wastafel yang penuh busa sabun.
scene.en: Mom washes the dishes in a sink full of soap bubbles.

scene.id: Toilet yang bersih dengan wastafel; Adik mencuci tangan dengan sabun. Di pintunya ada ikon toilet.
scene.en: A clean restroom with a sink; Little Sister washes her hands with soap. A restroom icon is on the door.

scene.id: Bola ada di rak paling bawah; Kakak berjongkok mengambilnya. Panah menunjuk rak bawah.
scene.en: A ball is on the bottom shelf; Big Brother crouches to get it. An arrow points at the bottom shelf.

scene.id: Adik melompat turun dari pintu bus ke halte; panah mengarah ke luar bus.
scene.en: Little Sister hops down from the bus door onto the stop; an arrow points out of the bus.

scene.id: Kakak kalah main ping-pong dari teman kuliahnya dan mengepalkan tangan; di balon pikiran di depannya, ia menang dan memegang piala.
scene.en: Big Brother loses at ping-pong to his classmate and clenches his fist; in a thought bubble ahead of him, he wins and holds a trophy.

scene.id: Panel 1 berangka 1: Adik mencuci tangan. Panel 2 berangka 2: Adik makan.
scene.en: Panel 1, numbered 1: Little Sister washes her hands. Panel 2, numbered 2: she eats.

scene.id: Adik meluncur di perosotan taman bermain sambil tertawa, tangannya terangkat.
scene.en: Little Sister whooshes down a playground slide, laughing with her hands in the air.

scene.id: Di toko, Ayah dengan sopan memanggil penjual muda di balik meja kasir sambil mengangkat satu tangan.
scene.en: In a shop, Dad politely calls to the young saleswoman behind the counter, raising one hand.

scene.id: Kakek tertawa terbahak-bahak; matanya menyipit dan tangannya memegangi perut.
scene.en: Grandpa laughs out loud, eyes squeezed shut and hands on his belly.

scene.id: Malam Tahun Baru: kembang api meledak di atas gedung; Ayah dan Ibu memegang lampion merah, Adik memegang angpau.
scene.en: New Year's Eve: fireworks burst over the buildings; Mom and Dad hold red lanterns and Little Sister holds a red envelope.

scene.id: Adik memegang bola dan minta izin main di luar; Ayah mengangguk dan membuat tanda OK dengan jarinya.
scene.en: Little Sister holds a ball and asks to play outside; Dad nods and makes an OK sign with his fingers.

scene.id: Kampus dengan gedung bata merah dan tangga lebar; Kakak membawa buku dan melangkah masuk.
scene.en: A campus with red-brick buildings and wide steps; Big Brother, carrying books, walks in.

scene.id: Kakek berkacamata dan berambut putih menyiram tanaman di balkon apartemen.
scene.en: Grandpa, with glasses and white hair, waters the plants on the apartment balcony.

scene.id: Buku terbuka dengan angka halaman 25 di pojok bawah; Adik membalik halamannya.
scene.en: An open book with page number 25 in the bottom corner; Little Sister turns the page.

scene.id: Adik menunggu di depan microwave yang sedang memanaskan susu; jam pasir kecil di atasnya hampir habis.
scene.en: Little Sister waits in front of the microwave warming her milk; a small hourglass above it is nearly run out.

scene.id: Kakak dan teman kuliahnya pulang bareng, berbagi satu payung di bawah hujan.
scene.en: Big Brother and his classmate walk home together, sharing one umbrella in the rain.

scene.id: Dua apel yang persis sama berdampingan dengan tanda sama dengan di antaranya; Adik membandingkannya dengan teliti.
scene.en: Two identical apples side by side with an equals sign between them; Little Sister compares them closely.

scene.id: Kakak berjalan sambil makan bakpao dan melihat ponsel sekaligus.
scene.en: Big Brother walks while eating a steamed bun and looking at his phone at the same time.

scene.id: Seluruh keluarga Xiǎo berbaris dan bersama-sama menarik sebuah lobak raksasa dari kebun.
scene.en: The whole Xiǎo family lines up and pulls a giant radish out of the garden together.

scene.id: Ayah memakai palu untuk memasang paku di dinding, lalu menggantung bingkai foto.
scene.en: Dad uses a hammer to drive a nail into the wall, then hangs a photo frame.

scene.id: Seekor panda di kebun binatang dikerumuni banyak pengunjung yang memotretnya dengan ponsel.
scene.en: A panda at the zoo is surrounded by crowds of visitors taking photos of it with their phones.

scene.id: Kalender mingguan: beberapa kotak bergambar payung, kotak-kotak lainnya bergambar matahari.
scene.en: A weekly calendar: a few boxes have an umbrella in them, the others have a sun.

scene.id: Saat hujan, Adik tetap kering di bawah payungnya, sementara Kakak di sebelahnya basah kuyup tanpa payung.
scene.en: In the rain, Little Sister stays dry under her umbrella while Big Brother next to her is soaked without one.

scene.id: Adik memegang sumpit dengan tangan kanannya; panah besar mengarah ke kanan.
scene.en: Little Sister holds her chopsticks in her right hand; a big arrow points right.

scene.id: Di eskalator stasiun metro, Ayah berdiri di sisi kanan, sementara sisi kiri dibiarkan kosong untuk orang yang berjalan; panah menunjuk ke kanan.
scene.en: On a metro escalator, Dad stands on the right side, leaving the left side clear for people walking; an arrow points right.

scene.id: Ayah menunjuk menara yang tampak kecil sekali di ujung jalan panjang, jauh di cakrawala; pohon di dekat mereka tampak besar.
scene.en: Dad points to a tower that looks tiny at the end of a long road, far off on the horizon; the tree beside them looks big.

scene.id: Adik berpiyama duduk santai di sofa rumah, sementara di luar jendela orang-orang bergegas berangkat kerja.
scene.en: Little Sister in pyjamas lounges on the sofa at home while outside the window people hurry off to work.

scene.id: Di kereta metro yang penuh, Kakak berdiri berpegangan pada pegangan tangan, sementara Kakek duduk di kursi.
scene.en: On a crowded metro train, Big Brother stands holding the handrail while Grandpa sits on a seat.

scene.id: Adik akhirnya menemukan boneka beruangnya di bawah tempat tidur dan mengangkatnya dengan gembira.
scene.en: Little Sister finally finds her teddy bear under the bed and holds it up with joy.

scene.id: Pintu terbuka lebar, lampu menyala, dan TV menyala, tapi tidak ada seorang pun di ruangan itu.
scene.en: The door is wide open, the lamp is on and the TV is on, but there is nobody in the room.

scene.id: Kakak merentangkan tangan menceritakan ikan sebesar ini; Adik tidak percaya (tanda tanya); Kakak menunjukkan fotonya di ponsel sebagai bukti.
scene.en: Big Brother stretches his arms wide describing a fish this big; Little Sister doesn't believe him (question mark); he shows her the photo on his phone as proof.

scene.id: Kakek meluruskan bingkai foto yang miring di dinding sampai tegak lurus.
scene.en: Grandpa straightens a crooked photo frame on the wall until it hangs perfectly straight.

scene.id: Kakek membaca buku tebal; bohlam lampu dan bintang-bintang kecil mengalir dari buku ke kepalanya.
scene.en: Grandpa reads a thick book; light bulbs and little stars flow from the book into his head.

scene.id: Anak panah tertancap tepat di titik tengah papan sasaran; Kakak bersorak.
scene.en: A dart sticks right in the centre of the dartboard; Big Brother cheers.

scene.id: Adik duduk di tengah, di antara Ayah dan Ibu, di sofa.
scene.en: Little Sister sits in the middle, between Dad and Mom, on the sofa.

scene.id: Kakak terhuyung-huyung mengangkat koper berat dengan dua tangan; di sebelahnya Adik memegang balon ringan dengan satu jari.
scene.en: Big Brother staggers as he lifts a heavy suitcase with both hands; next to him Little Sister holds a light balloon with one finger.

scene.id: Ibu dengan hati-hati memasukkan paspor dan tiket ke tasnya; tanda seru besar di atasnya.
scene.en: Mom carefully tucks the passport and tickets into her bag; a big exclamation mark above.

scene.id: Kakak berjongkok di garis start dengan posisi siap, menunggu aba-aba.
scene.en: Big Brother crouches at the starting line in the ready position, waiting for the signal.

scene.id: Lima benda berjajar yang namanya berakhiran "-zi": meja, kursi, gelas, rumah, dan bakpao, dihubungkan oleh satu garis berwarna.
scene.en: Five things in a row whose names end in "-zi": a table, a chair, a cup, a house and a steamed bun, linked by one coloured line.

scene.id: Kakek berjalan santai di taman dengan tongkatnya.
scene.en: Grandpa strolls through the park with his walking stick.

scene.id: Kakak dan Adik berjalan kaki ke sekolah di trotoar dengan tas di punggung.
scene.en: Big Brother and Little Sister walk to school along the pavement with bags on their backs.

scene.id: Tiga semangka berjajar dari kecil sampai besar; yang paling besar diberi bintang.
scene.en: Three watermelons in a row from small to large; the biggest one has a star.

scene.id: Langit mendung; sebelum Kakak keluar, Ibu menyodorkan payung sambil menunjuk ke langit.
scene.en: The sky is cloudy; before Big Brother heads out, Mom hands him an umbrella and points at the sky.

scene.id: Tinggal satu pangsit terakhir di piring; Kakak dan Adik sama-sama mengincarnya dengan sumpit.
scene.en: One last dumpling is left on the plate; Big Brother and Little Sister both go for it with their chopsticks.

scene.id: Adik mengangkat tangan kirinya yang memakai gelang merah; panah besar mengarah ke kiri.
scene.en: Little Sister raises her left hand, which wears a red bracelet; a big arrow points left.

scene.id: Kakek, Adik, dan Nenek duduk berjajar di bangku; Kakek ada di ujung kiri, dan panah menunjuk sisi kiri.
scene.en: Grandpa, Little Sister and Grandma sit in a row on a bench; Grandpa is at the left end, and an arrow points to the left side.

scene.id: Adik yang kelelahan menjatuhkan diri duduk di bangku taman; panah ke bawah.
scene.en: Tired Little Sister plops down onto a park bench; a down arrow.
